title: Panel Toggle Border Between Toggles
description: The panel toggle should show a border between the toggles e.g. history and settings
summary: Fixed panel-tab borders across both states. The earlier follow-up restored normal logical-end dividers after the panel/chrome renderer bypassed panelTabButtonClass, and pinned their color to --border-normal-color so active fill styling cannot hide them. This follow-up restores the missing content-facing normal edge only while the panel is uncollapsed: top-anchored panels receive a bottom border and bottom-anchored panels receive a top border; collapsed tabs continue deferring their outer outline to the shared window silhouette. Extended the existing Panel test to assert collapsed versus uncollapsed behavior in both directions. Verified the expanded-border regression and the existing divider/U-gap regression pass; ui-styling quick passes 24/24.
